reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: "Thanks Marcus, noted: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. (Thistle) is due 24 December. Nothing else needed from me."

The brain had already saved his message as a fact. A deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and he posted it in the channel himself, so no approval was needed and I took no other action.
